verdict.rationale: Framer's own docs describe two write-capable surfaces. Plugins can insert images, layers and code components or modify anything on the canvas. A native External Agent connection gives Claude Code, Cursor and Codex direct access to the canvas, components and CMS to update a project, with full CMS create/update/delete and changes isolated on a branch. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of external-agent canvas edits, documented detail on which design operations the Server API or agent connection can write (beyond CMS and publishing).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can create or modify designs programmatically — through a write-capable API, plugin surface, or MCP tools — not just read them

citations.quote: They enable you to perform various actions such as inserting images, layers and code components or modifying anything on the Canvas.
the native Framer External Agent connection gives Claude Code, Cursor, Codex... direct access to your canvas, components, CMS, and project context, without manual MCP setup.
Connect Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor to update a Framer project.
Once connected, the agent can read and write CMS collections, including creating, updating, and deleting items.
every change made by an external agent automatically happens on a branch.
